'''Bangcaps''' were small explosive charges.

Traditionally used in conjunction with the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[B'hedda/Legends|b'hedda]], bangcaps were small charges that could be used as thrown projectiles. Upon detonation, bangcaps would explode with a bright flash and a loud clap. They were typically less powerful than a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot (though still potentially fatal), and were usually used for disorientation and confusion.
